name: kiss
description: Keep It Simple Stupid Workflow harness

plugins.name: kiss
plugins.description: Keep It Simple Stupid Workflow harness: one implementer, one reviewer that uses the running product, and tickets with acceptance tests. Also kiss-system-design (from a product idea to a run plan), kiss-code-clean (a ranked clean-up list of a code base), kiss-housekeeping (docs clean-up and a docs gate), kiss-mini-agent, kiss-doctor and kiss-dream ("tidy up memory").
